competitor.label: mcp-datetime 0.2.0, dated conversion and business/calendar tools

tasks.prompt: When it is 09:00 on 2026-10-15 in Tokyo, what time is it in New York? Give HH:MM in 24-hour time.
A call is set for 10:00 New York time on 2026-03-16. What time is that in London? Give HH:MM in 24-hour time.
Does the local time 02:30 on 2026-03-08 exist in New York? Answer yes or no.
On 2026-10-15, what is Kathmandu's UTC offset? Give it as +HH:MM.
When it is 18:00 on 2026-12-31 in Los Angeles, what is the date and time in Auckland? Give YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
On what date does daylight saving time end in the United Kingdom in 2026? Give YYYY-MM-DD.
Is 2026-01-06 a public holiday in Bavaria, Germany? Answer yes or no.
In England, what date is 10 business days after 2026-12-18, skipping weekends and bank holidays? Give YYYY-MM-DD.
How many business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US federal public holidays) are there in December 2026 in the United States? Give the number only.
What day of the week is 2027-03-14? Give the day name only.
What is the ISO 8601 week number of 2027-01-01? Give the number only.
What date is one calendar month after 2027-01-31, clamping to the end of the month? Give YYYY-MM-DD.

On 2026-12-22, people in New York (09:00-17:00 local), London (08:00-18:00 local) and Berlin (09:00-17:00 local) need a 60-minute meeting inside everyone's hours. What is the earliest start time in UTC? Give HH:MM.
One calendar month after 2027-01-31, clamping to month end, a call starts at 09:00 in New York. What is its date and time in Tokyo? Give YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
In England a deadline is 10 business days after 2026-12-18, excluding weekends and bank holidays. At 09:00 London time on that date, what date and time is it in New York? Give YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

On 2026-12-22, New York (09:00-17:00), London (08:00-18:00) and Berlin (09:00-17:00) need a 60-minute meeting within all working hours. What is the earliest start date and time in Tokyo? Give YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

Clamp one calendar month after 2027-01-31, then take the first England business day strictly after that date. At 17:00 London time that day, what is the local date and time in Kathmandu? Give YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

A Munich office is scheduled to reopen on 2026-01-06 at 09:00. If that date is a Bavarian public holiday, move reopening to its next business day. What is the resulting London date and time? Give YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
At 00:30 in Auckland on 2027-01-01, a New York office labels its report using the ISO week of its own local date. What is that ISO year and week? Give YYYY-Www.
A New York shift on 2026-03-08 runs from 01:30 to 03:30 local time across the DST change. How many elapsed minutes does it last? Give the number only.
A New York shift on 2026-11-01 runs from 00:30 to 02:30 local time across the DST change. How many elapsed minutes does it last? Give the number only.
A Sydney shift on 2026-10-04 runs from 01:30 to 03:30 local time across the DST change. How many elapsed minutes does it last? Give the number only.

On 2026-03-16, New York (09:00-17:00), London (08:00-18:00) and Berlin (09:00-17:00) need a 60-minute meeting within working hours. A Tokyo office labels it using the ISO week of its own local start date. What is that ISO year and week? Give YYYY-Www.
Was 2026-06-15 a bank holiday in Scotland? Answer yes or no.
